rationale: Quality remediation (security-gate integrity). Moves gate authority to the F# implementation and keeps Python as an expiring conformance oracle (docs/decisions/0001-gate-authority.md). Binds exception approval to the role registry: a verified human security-owner who is not the requester, within the exception's validity window. Introduces the canonical sensitive-data catalog, which the gate applies to evidence keys and values; this strengthens the gate by adding passwd, api-key and other spellings, and credential-shaped values. Publishes tutela.verification/1. Adds the F# gate files, catalog and schemas to protectedPaths.
weakeningAnalysis: No protected rule is removed or relaxed. Behavior changes are all fail-closed: self-asserted exceptions no longer reach CONDITIONAL; more sensitive keys and values make evidence INDETERMINATE; and the F# authority returns INDETERMINATE or unavailable where the oracle would crash. The ROLE-REGISTRY and PROVENANCE-AUTHORITY policies are unchanged.
changedBy: Claude Code implementation agent (Echelon quality-remediation, session_01CmPhre2cFonbHerxVSsmrL)
approvalRequired: An independent security-owner or security-reviewer, recorded in security/ROLE-REGISTRY.json, must review this transition and add an approval with evidence before merge. The implementing agent cannot approve its own change (TUT-0006, AGENTS.md rules 3-4). The CI transition check verifies only paths and digests; it does not establish approval.
